name: What does an exterior weathering assessment report include?

mainEntity.name: What does an exterior weathering assessment report include?

acceptedAnswer.text: An exterior weathering assessment report typically includes a detailed description of the roof's condition, identifying specific areas of wear, material degradation, and potential issues. It will often feature photographic evidence of observed weathering, such as granule loss, surface cracking, or moss growth. The report also provides an estimated remaining service life of the roof and recommendations for maintenance, repair, or replacement. Our reports are designed to give clear, actionable insights into your roof's health.
acceptedAnswer.description: The report details roof condition, identifies wear with photos, estimates remaining lifespan, and recommends maintenance or repairs.
